subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 stop claiming to close this issue because its fs-safe hardlink change is unrelated to the reported pi-tools failures?
rationale: The issue appears implemented already, but the review contract requires it to stay open while an open PR carries explicit closing syntax; only a maintainer should correct or intentionally accept that relationship.

options.title: Correct the PR relationship
options.body: Remove the closing reference from the fs-safe PR, retain it as independent Windows test coverage, and close this issue separately as implemented.

options.title: Treat this as a Windows test umbrella
options.body: Keep the relationship only if maintainers intentionally broaden this issue to cover unrelated Windows filesystem test coverage.

recommendation.title: Correct the PR relationship
recommendation.body: Remove the closing reference from the fs-safe PR, retain it as independent Windows test coverage, and close this issue separately as implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete supplied the most detailed prior review and has the strongest recent history across the affected test surface.
